'''TheJungus Saber Squadron v2''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[TheJungus]]
* '''Published:''' 5 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Executor: Control Station|Dagobah-D-executorcontrolstation.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Executor: Control Station
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Executor Control Station TheJungu.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

My old Saber Squadron, now with improvements from ur comments...

== Strategy ==

Well, I took into consideration most of your ideas, and decided on a rough version of my new deck.  Everything with stars are proxies because i dont have them yet, which could get a little annoying.  havent play-tested this version yet but will soon.

i know a couple said to put zuckuss in MH in, but i dont really see the ponit.  they only need 7 ability to counter his text, so my bro can bring over a couple corvettes, falcon with some pilots, and a couple other unique x-wings and now zuckuss is useless, bett i think to leave in more useful cards.  things like oppresive enforcement and scimitar 2/jonus prob wont leave because they save my butt.  chineraeu is good, but i can help but think that hes not quite worth it.  anyway, hes in, for now...
after i test this and play around with a little more, me write final deck with actual strategy :)
